SQL_STMT_U.val: UPDATE sale AS s JOIN invoice AS i ON i.bill_to_customer_id = s.billing_customer_id AND i.billing_end_date = ':3' SET s.billing_cutoff_date = ':3' WHERE s.id > 0 AND (:1 = 0 OR i.bill_to_customer_id = :1) AND s.sales_date BETWEEN i.billing_start_date AND i.billing_end_date AND s.sales_date BETWEEN ':2' AND ':3';

UPDATE receipt AS r JOIN invoice AS i ON i.bill_to_customer_id = r.billing_customer_id AND i.billing_end_date = ':3' SET r.billing_cutoff_date = ':3' WHERE r.id > 0 AND (:1 = 0 OR i.bill_to_customer_id = :1) AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN i.billing_start_date AND i.billing_end_date AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN ':2' AND ':3';
